rolex-126610ln.caption: Submariner Date on the black Cerachrom bezel, titled by the photographer as the 2020 model — the generation introduced as 126610LN. Identified from the photograph, not from a serial.

rolex-126710blro-pepsi.caption: GMT-Master II ref. 16710 "Pepsi" on Jubilee — the earlier aluminium-bezel generation, not the ceramic 126710BLRO.

patek-5711-1a.caption: Nautilus in steel with the blue embossed dial and date at 3 — the 5711/1A configuration, identified from the dial, case and bracelet rather than from a marked reference.

omega-speedmaster-3861.caption: Speedmaster Professional Moonwatch photographed in 2005, before the calibre 3861 update — same case, bezel and dial layout, earlier movement.

tudor-bb58-79030n.caption: Black Bay 58 in black — the 79030N configuration, shown on a rubber strap rather than the steel bracelet.

cartier-santos-wssa0018.caption: Santos de Cartier large model in steel with silvered dial and date — the WSSA0018 configuration, photographed in a Cartier boutique in Prague.

tissot-prx-t137-407.caption: PRX Powermatic 80 in 35 mm (T137.207) — the smaller sibling of the 40 mm T137.407, same case, bracelet and waffle dial.

patek-3700-1a.caption: Jumbo Nautilus ref. 3700/1A — the original 1976 Genta porthole, not the 5711. The 3700 is what the 5711 inherited the silhouette from.

ap-26470st.caption: Audemars Piguet Royal Oak Offshore — the 42mm chrono/Diver family. The 26470ST is a steel Diver; the image shows a 42mm Offshore from the same family.

rolex-124060.caption: BWG9 lume shot on a Submariner-Date-style Steeldive homage — the closest verified CC-licensed photograph in the public archive. The 124060 itself is the no-date 41mm Submariner introduced in 2020; the file shows a faithful homage in the same family.

rolex-126710blnr.caption: Rolex GMT-Master II ref. 126710BLNR — the "Batgirl" generation with black and blue Cerachrom bezel on Jubilee bracelet, released 2019.

rolex-126500ln.caption: Rolex Cosmograph Daytona — the file page shows a gold example of the family. The 126500LN is the 2023 steel-Cerachrom Panda; same case family, different metal.

rolex-1675.caption: Rolex GMT-Master II ref. 16710 — the immediate successor of the 1675. The 1675 ran 1959–1980 in steel with Pepsi bezel; the 16710 (1989–2007) is the closest licensed photograph on Commons.

rolex-126334.caption: Rolex Datejust II ref. 116334 — the 41mm Datejust generation. The 126334 is its immediate 2017 successor, same case profile, updated movement.

mbf-lm101.caption: MB&F Legacy Machine 101 in platinum — the M.A.D.-edition entry in the LM line, with a 45° suspended balance wheel.

ap-25721st.caption: Audemars Piguet Royal Oak Offshore — the 42mm Diver configuration. The 25721ST is the 1990s Royal Oak Offshore chronograph in the same case family; this is the closest verified CC photograph for the family.

cartier-tank-louis.caption: Cartier Tank Louis Cartier in gold, ref. 96065 — the 25.5 × 33.5mm Louis Cartier dress watch, the direct ancestor of the modern Tank Louis.

breitling-navitimer-b01-43.caption: Vintage Breitling Navitimer ref. 806 AOPA (c.1960) — the lineage the modern B01 43mm descends from. Closest verified CC photograph for the family.

zenith-chronomaster-original.caption: Zenith El Primero 21 — the 1/100-second chronograph that uses the same El Primero movement family as the Chronomaster Original. The 03.A3842 variant shows the modern case.

zenith-a386-revival.caption: Vintage Zenith El Primero A385 (1970s) — the tri-color sub-dial layout the modern A386 Revival reproduces. The 1969 A386 was Zenith's first El Primero execution.

jlc-reverso-classic-q3858520.caption: Jaeger-LeCoultre Reverso — the 1931 swiveling-case design. The Q3858520 is the medium-thin Classic Duoface in steel.

omega-seamaster-300m.caption: Omega Seamaster — the dive-watch family. The 300m reference is the current-production James Bond Seamaster introduced in 2012.

iwc-big-pilot-iw501001.caption: IWC Big Pilot Saint-Exupéry Edition — the same 46mm Big Pilot case family as the IW501001. The IW501001 is the steel Big Pilot with the Pellaton winding system.

patek-5167a.caption: Patek Philippe Aquanaut Advanced Research ref. 5650G — a 500-piece limited edition of the Aquanaut line. The 5167A is the steel Aquanaut with the same case and embossed dial.

tudor-chrono-79360n.caption: Tudor Black Bay Chrono ref. 79350 — the steel panda-dial chronograph. The 79360N is the same generation with a black dial instead of the panda.

rolex-116400gv.caption: Rolex Milgauss 116400GV — the green-crystal anti-magnetic Rolex. Worn on White Lotus S3 and A Man in Full.

rolex-1016.caption: Rolex Explorer ref. 1016 — the longest-running Explorer (1963–1989). Worn by Jennifer Connelly's character in Top Gun: Maverick.

rolex-16710.caption: Rolex GMT-Master II ref. 16710 — the 1989–2007 generation, last with an aluminium bezel insert. Worn on The Blacklist.
